# Somatic @ Stage 10 — Concrete Peak

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Crosswalk (from unified ladder)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| IST Stage# | 10 |
| Canonical name | Concrete Peak |

| Kegan | 3 |

## Expression on this line

Somatic capacity at Order 9 is complex somatic integration: the practitioner coordinates
multiple body disciplines (yoga, martial arts, dance, somatic therapy, physical training)
into a coherent whole. The advance over Stage 9 is that somatic practice is no longer just
systematic but complex: multiple body dimensions are held in productive tension within one
coherent somatic life.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** the felt richness of a multi-dimensional somatic life.
- **UR:** reliable integration of multiple body disciplines into coherent somatic practice.
- **LL:** a somatic culture that values integration — communities that support multiple body
  dimensions simultaneously.
- **LR:** the institutional structures that provide platforms for integrated somatic practice.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** integration paralysis — holding so many body disciplines that no
  coherent somatic practice emerges.
- **Dark allergy:** integration failure — the practitioner cannot integrate multiple body
  dimensions.
- **Golden addiction:** claiming to have achieved somatic mastery (Stage 11) while actually
  just integrating multiple body disciplines.
- **Golden allergy:** refusing to engage with somatic integration because it dilutes purity of
  tradition.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Multi-discipline somatic practice:** the practitioner integrates multiple body disciplines
  into one coherent practice.
- **Cross-traditional somatic fluency:** the practitioner demonstrates competence across
  multiple body traditions.
- **Integrated somatic life:** multiple body dimensions are held in productive tension.

## Sources, joints, open questions

(felt sense as integrative body knowing).
